high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Times Entertainment section of the Times of India website. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 8:03, and various icons indicate the device's connectivity status, including Wi-Fi and battery life. The text explains that Agarwood is produced by infected Aquilaria trees, which are native to the dense rainforests of Southeast Asia.
